name: What types of wood are best for interior trim?

mainEntity.name: What types of wood are best for interior trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best type of wood for interior trim depends on whether you plan to paint or stain it. For paint-grade trim, common choices include MDF (medium-density fiberboard) for its cost-effectiveness and smooth finish, or clear pine. For stain-grade trim, popular options include oak for its distinct grain, maple for a smoother, lighter appearance, cherry for its rich color, or poplar if you want a natural wood look that's still paintable. Each has unique characteristics regarding durability, grain, and cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best wood for interior trim depends on whether it's painted (MDF, clear pine) or stained (oak, maple, cherry, poplar) for its grain and durability.
